Steam Audio 4.8.1, source-built for Virtual Spatial Mic
Upstream revision: 0da18255cca520771f363ee01f100572b39a308e
Copyright 2017-2023 Valve Corporation.
Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.

This build disables Intel IPP, Intel MKL, Intel Embree, AMD Radeon Rays,
AMD TrueAudio Next and FFTS. It uses PFFFT for FFT operations.
The retained upstream third-party notice covers multiple build configurations;
its sections for disabled dependencies do not mean those libraries are linked.

Included components: PFFFT, libmysofa, zlib, FlatBuffers headers,
CIPIC HRTF data, and Google's spherical harmonics code. Their original
copyright and license notices are retained with the corresponding sources.

Build changes: upstream zlib install configuration is adapted to install
the static target only. The build adapter supplies CMake CMP0091=NEW so
MSVC runtime selection is honored, and builds dependencies from preserved
source snapshots without resetting local modifications.

See Steam-Audio-APACHE-2.0.txt, Steam-Audio-THIRDPARTY.md,
Steam-Audio-OPEN-DEPENDENCIES.txt, and SOURCE.txt.
